title: callista aurea
intro: Callista aurea, commonly known as the golden clamshell mussel shell, is a type of marine bivalve mollusk. It is traditionally used as a medicinal plant in some cultures, valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Callista aurea include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Callista aurea include oligosaccharides, glycoproteins, and other polysaccharides, which are believed to exert therapeutic actions such as immune modulation and cell protection.
